summary: Master market research and consumer behavior in tourism. Join our training course to unlock valuable skills for understanding and engaging your audience.
lede: Tourism market research helps travel and hospitality professionals make decisions based on evidence about traveler needs and choices. It supports practical tasks such as shaping products and marketing for specific audiences, using skills to define research questions, choose methods, and gather useful data. Participants also learn to interpret travel decision patterns, identify market segments, and turn findings into recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals across the tourism industry who need to understand traveler behavior to make better business decisions.
audience: Tour operators and travel agency managers
Travel technology and OTA product managers
Marketing and brand managers in travel
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of tourism operations and some experience with data analysis or marketing. Familiarity with survey tools and digital analytics is beneficial but not required.
